name: agenticview
description: Gamified 3D office for your coding agents (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini) as a Claude Code plugin

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.release: npm run build && git diff --quiet -- packages/server/dist packages/web/dist || (echo "dist out of date: commit rebuilt bundles" && exit 1)
